title: County Outages Transfer Choropleth Atlas
goal: Build a standalone D3 web app that maps county-level outage severity from local GeoJSON and CSV files as a choropleth, with a synchronized ranked bar chart, legend, and hover/click details.
skillBenefitRationale: This moves the skill into geospatial visualization, where D3’s projection, geoPath, legend construction, and linked interactions are the only critical shipped capabilities.
